weighted_normalized_age.label: 本任务资产重要度加权归一巡检年龄
weighted_normalized_age.formula: I_c=(1/(H*sum_j a_cj))*integral_0^H sum_j a_cj*min((t-L_cjm(t))/D_j,1)dt; aggregate=mean_c(I_c), c=12 paired primary processes
weighted_normalized_age.age_origin: L=0 before first professional completion: virtual age origin, not a claimed initial measurement
weighted_normalized_age.reset: right-continuous reset at qualified professional measurement completion; arrival/remote telemetry/dispatch do not reset
weighted_normalized_age.terminal: H=1800 is integration boundary, not fictitious completion
weighted_normalized_age.gap_area_formula: F_D(g)=g^2/(2D) if 0<=g<=D, else g-D/2; each task area=sum_k F_D(g_k)
weighted_normalized_age.weight_source: Per-case Tour /local_decisions/*/public_tasks/* fixed weight, indexed by task. Saved weight=asset_weights/2; a=2*saved weight. Global scaling cancels in normalized score. Thermal criticality is saved task asset importance; each other profession uses mean criticality of its eight-rack pod. No observation/risk/temperature trajectory is borrowed. Complete task rows are constant within case; all methods share spec/process_sha256 and frozen task construction source.
weighted_normalized_age.registration_status: retrospective saved-data descriptive calculation, not preregistered acceptance outcome
weighted_normalized_age.difference_from_original_paper: Professional service completion / seconds / 300-600s task deadlines / static asset importance / time average differ from original neighborhood sampling / decision-step tau increments / information importance / terminal node-sum objective. Not original scale.
weighted_normalized_age.scalar_trace_difference: Not a mean of saved public_risk_age or mean_age_ratio, which use other risk weights/caps and sampled endpoints.

equal_task_normalized_age.meaning: auxiliary equal-task-weight score, not importance weighted

censored_confirmation_wait.formula: W_c=sum_i q_ci*d_ci/sum_i q_ci; d_ci=(first_confirmation_s if detected else end_s)-onset_s; table=mean_c(W_c) over 12 processes
censored_confirmation_wait.weight_source: Saved anomaly_intervals[].weight = task_asset_weight*(1+mean threshold-normalized excess during segment), per frozen evaluator. Consequence weight differs from static age weight.
censored_confirmation_wait.censoring: Misses censored at their anomaly end; not detected-only mean. Original preceding-bin sampled endpoint labels retained. For each retained contiguous segment, endpoint confirmation requires onset_s<completion_s<=end_s; an alarm exactly at onset belongs to preceding bin and is not automatically confirmation.

confirmation_ratio.independent_unit: 12 paired process seeds; 89 segments are not independent replications

revisit_violations.formula: sum_(c,j) 1[max(initial gap, inter-completion gaps, terminal gap)>D_j+1e-9]
revisit_violations.unit: task-episode pairs; each total covers 12*176=2112 protected task episodes

temperature_rmse_c.formula_if_inputs_retained: sqrt(mean((estimate-truth)^2)) on common aligned temperature target mask/time grid
temperature_rmse_c.status: missing primary aligned inputs; null, not zero

temperature_weighted_rmse_c.formula_if_inputs_retained: sqrt(sum(a*(estimate-truth)^2)/sum(a)) on aligned full rack-temperature target
temperature_weighted_rmse_c.status: weights recovered; aligned estimate/truth missing; null, not zero

temperature_r2.status: missing primary aligned inputs; null, not zero

single_step_inference_ms.meaning: nominal update/scheduler lack per-call timers; no history-model call does not mean 0ms
